articles.title: Balad Beast 2026 brings Playboi Carti and Destroy Lonely to Jeddah
articles.description: The UNESCO World Heritage Site of Al Balad will host a musical extravaganza.
articles.content: Saudi Arabia is turning up the volume. The Kingdom has welcomed international artists from around the world. Now, the first wave of artists for Balad Beast 2026 has been announced, and includes hip–hop heavyweights Playboi Carti and Destroy Lonely.

articles.title: Gunna’s Wun World Tour Proves He’s “Made For This Sh*t”
articles.content: A dense fog covered Inglewood, Calif., as fans made their way through a maze of overfilled parking lots and hot dog vendors to the YouTube Theater for the Los Angeles stop of Gunna’s World Wun Tour.

articles.title: Future and Louis Vuitton: luxury's recognition of contemporary rap
articles.description: Rapper Future has been named a “Friend of the House” for luxury brand Louis Vuitton.
articles.content: Future, whose real name is Nayvadius Wilburn, is an American rapper, singer, songwriter and producer. He was born in 1983 in Atlanta, Georgia, US. At the 2025 Met Gala, themed “Superfine: Tailoring Black Style”, Future was dressed in Louis Vuitton. He also attended the house’s spring/summer 2026 menswear show at the invitation of his friend and creative collaborator, Pharrell Williams.
